Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Large Battery Operated Square Art Deco Wood Wall Clock - 27 Inch, White
Colors: White
Materials: hardwood
Hints of Art Deco make this clock a striking piece of wall art, even as it keeps you on time. Black iron accents bring an industrial twist to the vintage feel. Stark black on white provides eye-catching décor for most any kind of room. 27.75" Diameter Hardwood with iron detailing and numerals Ready to hang, all hardware included
